correctness.rationale: For n>=2 all maximal geodesics of \(K_2\square K_2\square K_n\) are four-vertex paths using each coordinate once. In a perfect packing, exactly two paths touch every 4-vertex square fiber. Their footprints split as 2+2 or 3+1. The 2+2 footprints force alternating binary-edge directions along incidence cycles; the 3+1 footprints force a closed adjacency walk on bipartite \(Q_2\). Both enforce even cycles. Every even cycle incidence graph is constructively realized using complementary parallel fiber-edges and perpendicular adjacent-fiber transitions. Pairing columns attains 2 floor(n/2) paths, and odd n cannot attain n. The labeled-component exponential formula yields exp(z^2/4)(1-z^2)^(-1/4). Independent exact graph recursion checked n=2,3,4; witnesses through n=12 and n<=4 exhaustive perfect enumeration corroborate but are not used for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The sharp two-parity packing number and precise realizability of even-cycle incidence multigraphs resolve a natural infinite family of 3-factor Hamming graphs and expose a global obstruction invisible in the known volume bound. The formula counts all attainable labeled incidence patterns and separates graph-packability from unrestricted cycle enumeration. The proof uses structural 1+3 and 2+2 fiber configurations; it is not simply an elementary parameter substitution or a tiny numerical improvement. Broader products and actual counts of packings remain open in this work.
